Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Added a heads-up notice that takes over the window whenever the relay needs to restart for an update, so a dropped connection doesn't come as a surprise. Report a Bug now automatically captures a lot more diagnostic info (display resolution, DPI scaling, GPU, Dalamud version, and more) to help track down issues faster.
